stories.title: Switzerland approves its first Bitcoin ETF after ruling trading volume is sufficient
stories.summary: Swiss regulators approved a Bitcoin ETF. The approval came after regulators ruled that trading volume in the underlying market meets the required threshold. CryptoSlate calls it a landmark decision for Switzerland.
stories.whyItMatters: A national regulator's approval signals growing comfort with crypto market structure and may open new institutional capital flows.
whatToWatch: The ETF's launch date and initial trading volume
Whether other regulators cite this ruling as precedent
questions: Which issuer and exchange will list the ETF?
What volume threshold did regulators apply?

sources.title: Switzerland approves landmark Bitcoin ETF after ruling trading volume sufficient

stories.title: Kazakhstan blocks mobile access to six major crypto exchanges
stories.summary: Kazakhstan cut off mobile access to six large crypto exchanges, according to CryptoSlate. The restriction limits how residents reach these platforms through phone apps or mobile browsers.
stories.whyItMatters: The move shows tightening state control over crypto access in Central Asia and may push users toward workarounds like VPNs or peer-to-peer trading.
whatToWatch: Whether the exchanges or Kazakh authorities issue a response
Whether desktop access is restricted next
questions: Which six exchanges are affected?
What reason did authorities give for the block?

sources.title: Kazakhstan shuts down mobile access to 6 major crypto exchanges

stories.title: Kraken's $80 stablecoin fee gap exposes hidden costs
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports an $80 gap in Kraken's stablecoin fees, pointing to hidden costs for users converting or moving stablecoins on the exchange. Details on which stablecoin and transaction type are limited.
stories.whyItMatters: Fee transparency affects how traders compare exchanges and choose where to hold or move stablecoins.
whatToWatch: Whether Kraken responds or adjusts its fee structure
questions: Which stablecoin and transaction type created the $80 gap?
Do other exchanges have similar gaps?

sources.title: Kraken’s $80 stablecoin fee gap exposes hidden costs

stories.title: BNB Chain burns $1.2 billion in tokens in October, but real supply impact stays unclear
stories.summary: BNB Chain completed its latest token burn, destroying about $1.2 billion worth of BNB in October, CryptoSlate reports. The report says the burn's true effect on circulating supply is harder to pin down than the headline figure suggests.
stories.whyItMatters: Burn size drives the scarcity narrative investors use to value BNB, so unclear supply math matters for anyone pricing the token.
whatToWatch: The next scheduled burn and its disclosed methodology
questions: What offsets the burn's effect on circulating supply?
How is the burn amount calculated and verified?

sources.title: BNB Chain burns $1.2B in October tokens, leaving real supply impact hidden

stories.title: Drift hacker launders $63 million through Tornado Cash, clouding recovery hopes
stories.summary: The attacker behind the Drift protocol hack moved $63 million through the Tornado Cash mixer, according to CryptoSlate. The move complicates efforts to trace or recover the stolen funds.
stories.whyItMatters: Each unresolved DeFi hack tests whether mixers can still shield large sums and whether victims get any funds back.
whatToWatch: Any law enforcement or sanctions action tied to the funds
Whether Drift announces a reimbursement plan for affected users
questions: Who is behind the Drift hack?
Can any of the laundered funds be frozen or traced further?

sources.title: Drift hacker washes $63M through Tornado Cash, leaving recovery claims in limbo

stories.title: JPMorgan models $385,000 Bitcoin in 10-year bull case, even as Dimon stays skeptical
stories.summary: JPMorgan published a model putting Bitcoin at $385,000 in a bull-case scenario over 10 years, per CryptoSlate. The projection comes even as CEO Jamie Dimon continues to criticize Bitcoin publicly.
stories.whyItMatters: Big-bank models shape institutional sentiment, but a decade-out bull case is a scenario, not a forecast, and deserves skepticism.
whatToWatch: Whether JPMorgan publishes a base case or bear case alongside this scenario
Any shift in Dimon's public stance on Bitcoin
questions: What assumptions drive the $385,000 figure?
How does this bull case compare to JPMorgan's base-case projection?

sources.title: JPMorgan models Bitcoin reaching $385,000 in 10-year bull case despite CEO Jamie Dimon’s criticism

stories.title: Traders still betting on a Bitcoin rebound could amplify the next selloff
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that traders holding positions betting on a Bitcoin recovery could make the next price drop worse, if those bets get forced to unwind. This is a market-structure observation, not a price prediction, and the supplied details are limited.
stories.whyItMatters: Leveraged positioning shapes how sharp a downside move can get, which matters for anyone sizing risk in Bitcoin.
whatToWatch: Funding rates and open interest data for signs of crowded long positioning
Liquidation volumes if prices move lower
questions: What specific positioning data supports this claim?
Over what time frame is this risk expected to play out?

sources.title: Bitcoin’s next selloff could be amplified by the traders still betting on its recovery

stories.title: US orders DeepSeek removed from federal systems as Chinese AI rival opens up its technology
stories.summary: The US ordered DeepSeek purged from federal systems, CryptoSlate reports, even as the Chinese AI firm opens its technology more broadly to outside users. The order reflects ongoing US scrutiny of Chinese AI tools in government use.
stories.whyItMatters: US-China tech restrictions shape the regulatory climate around AI broadly, which can spill into sentiment for AI-linked crypto tokens.
whatToWatch: Whether the order extends beyond federal systems to contractors or broader bans
questions: What specific security concerns prompted the order?
How does DeepSeek's wider release affect its global user base?

sources.title: US orders DeepSeek purge from federal systems as Chinese AI rival opens its technology to the world

stories.title: Elon Musk and Anthropic unveil AI wealth-sharing plans that could reach $110 billion
stories.summary: Elon Musk and Anthropic announced plans for sharing AI-generated wealth that could total more than $110 billion, according to CryptoSlate. Details on structure and timeline are limited in the supplied report.
stories.whyItMatters: Large AI wealth-distribution proposals can shift how investors value AI-exposed tokens and companies, an area that often overlaps with crypto markets.
whatToWatch: Formal terms or a timeline for the proposed wealth-sharing plan
questions: How would the $110 billion figure actually be distributed, and to whom?
Is this a binding commitment or a stated aspiration?

sources.title: Elon Musk and Anthropic unveil AI wealth-sharing plans that could reach over $110 billion

stories.title: XRP Ledger's booming activity faces scrutiny as 110 bot wallets dominate RLUSD payments
stories.summary: A report cited by CryptoSlate finds that just 110 bot wallets account for the bulk of RLUSD stablecoin payment activity on the XRP Ledger. The finding raises questions about how much of the network's recent activity surge reflects genuine use.
stories.whyItMatters: Anyone tracking XRP Ledger adoption needs to know how much of its volume is organic versus bot-driven.
whatToWatch: Whether Ripple or XRPL developers respond to the findings
Further on-chain analysis of RLUSD payment patterns
questions: Who operates the 110 bot wallets, and why?
Does this activity resemble wash trading or serve a legitimate function?

sources.title: XRP Ledger’s booming activity faces scrutiny as 110 bot wallets dominate RLUSD payments
